tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// yang zlog me'i spu gri'i gtor mas zlog pa'i las sgrub pa'i lag len bzhugs so//

ya mā ri na mo/ yang zlog me'i spu gri'i srung zlog bsad mnan gyi sgrub pa'am srung zlog rkyang pa'i sgrub pa sogs ngag mtshams mi byed par gtor zlog tsam la brten par byed na/ lcags snod du 'bru nag rjen btags la sngar gyi gtor zan rnying pa'i phabs rgyun dang btsan dug chang khrag gis sbrus pa'i gtor ma bra gzugs la logs gsum dbal gnyis dang dbus su khram ris can/ brang nag po/ dbal khrag gis byugs par dkar dmar gyi rgyan dang rtse rgyan thog mde'u lta bu phyag mtshan gyis spras pa/ 'khor bshos bu gru gsum bzhi dmar gyis brgyan pa mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon bzhir bzhag /phyi skor du mda' dar ram rgyal mtshan phyogs mdog /drag po'i shing gi rtsang stod smad ro sol khrag dang sbyar bas nag po/ sked pa gri khrag dang btsag gis dmar por byugs pa bsnol mar btsugs pa'i rtse mor sha dum dang liṅga mgo thur bstan re bskyon/ gtso 'khor la rgyan rtsang dang mtshe yungs gzugs/ gal che na bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gzhung ltar bris la bltabs pa tshon skud gyis bcings pa gtor gdugs nag po'i dbus su bzhugs/ zlog pa rkyang pa'i 'khor lo sham 'dogs can gtor ma gtso bo'i sum cha yar bcad sum cha gnyis mar bcad pa'i mtshams su bcug /'khor bzhi la'ang rang rang gi sngags zlog sham btags pa dril la bcug /'bru nag gi chos 'byung rim gsum gyi dbus su tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i steng du khri'i khar bsham/ de dag gi mtha' skor du/ khrag chen gyi ar+ghaṃ/ dug khrag gi zhabs bsil/ dbang po lnga'i me tog /sha chen dang gu gul sbyar ba'i spos/ mkhris chen chang dang sbyar ba'i dri chab/ lha bshos dmar po zur gsum sha khrag rus pas sbags pa/ rdza rnga rkang gling gi rol mo rnams g.yon skor du bshams/ gtor zor nas 'bras gro sran so ba lnga rjen che'i zur gsum dug khrag byugs pa mda' mdung mtshe yungs rtsang gis brgyan pa thod pa'i lcags snod du bshams/

yang thod pa'i lcags snod du sran ma bra bo sogs 'bru nag gi phye mar liṅga mkhyid gang pa dmigs bya yod na de'i ming rus dug khrag gis bris pa snying gar bcug cing dri mas sbags pa dang*/ bgegs yin na de gnas pa'i sa chu shing sogs dang ming bris pa dug khrag byugs pa khong par bcug cing phyi la'ang dug khrag byugs pa phung re'am dar ras nag po bkab pa gtor ma'i mdun du bshams/ gzhan yang sman raka/ thun/ phur pa/ gri lcags kyi ral gri| gtun bu/ gtun/ g.yab dar la sogs pa mkho ba'i rdzas thams cad ma 'dzoms pa med pa bshams/ rang nyid stan bde bar 'dug la/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems dang cha gsum gtor ma btang*/ ngag 'don gzhung bsrangs la srung sngags brgya stong sogs bzlas la nyal/ phyi nangs nas tho rangs skyabs sems dang ngag 'don bsrung ba'i kha bsgyur byas pa gzhung bsrangs pas bdag dang gtor ma lhan cig tu lhar bskyed/ nyi shar bar srung bsngags bzla/ nyin shar thun gtor la dgug gzhug thabs mchog bde chen ma sbas lha gnyis sbyar bas gtor chen la bstab sman raka bsgron la/ slar thun gtor gcig bsham sman raka bsgron la bzhag /slar ngag 'don gyi dmigs pa thugs ka'i 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar nag ces pa nas g.yo 'gul med par gyur bar brjod cing zlog pa'i dmigs pa bsgyur la zlog sngags la 'bad/ nyin gung gi thun la tshogs mchod dang bskang bshags bya/ dgong nyi ma grib so gug pa dang*/ gtor chung sha khrag rus pa dang sbrags pa lnga/ drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs ltar byas la bstod ring gi ba ling sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la zer dus re re nas gtor chen la bstab sman raka bsgron la/ de rjes nya bo dang phur thun mtshon cha gtun bu g.yab dar sogs rang gi mdun du bshams la/ gtor chen la sha zan dang sman raka bran la zlog pa'i phrin las gzhung bsrang zhing gyer/ de rjes gser skyems bshams la mkhyen dgongs dpang 'dzugs dmod bcol bya/

brub khung bskyed chog byas la dgug gzhug drag po ci mang gi mthar gzu dpang bla dgug bla dbye bya/ byad ma rang gshed du bskul ba/ nyes byas drag bskul dang*/ mon pa bzhi bskul dang*/ sde brgyad 'byung tshul ltar bskul ba dang*/ so sdebs dregs pa'i bskul/ slar kiṃ kang gi bla 'gugs dang lha dbye bya/ thun bskul byas la thun brab/ byang chub lam bstan yang byas la/ slar phur gdab dang bsgral zhing gtun brdung rgyas par bya/ bsgral ba'i ling ro gtor mar bstab cing sman raka bsgron la/ bstab po dang*/ gsang ba gsol gdab mnga' gsol bya/ zlog byang chung ba yang gtang*/ rtags bstod sogs ci 'grub bya/ srod thun la na mo bla ma'i thal mo brdabs rjes/ thun gtor dgug gzhug gsum dang drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs gtor bsngos byas la/ drag bskul lam bstod ring gru gsum mthing nag ma gang rung gis bskul la/ lcags sam bhan+dha dang*/ zlog sngags dang*/ 'byung ba khram zlog dang*/ rbod gtong drag po'i zor 'phen pa'i sngags sdebs dang bcas pa bzla zhing phyir 'phang*/ thun gtor gcig bshams la sman raka bran la bzhag /tshul de lta bu zhag gsum/ lnga/ bdun/ dgu sogs gal che chung dang long skabs dang bstun pa byas rjes| nub tha ma mnga' gsol gyi rjes su thog steng du/ gser skyems 'bul/ gtor zor lcags sam bhan+dhas zlog sngags rbod gtong drag po'i zor 'phen pa'i sngags sdebs dang 'byung ba khram zlog dang bcas gang dmigs pa'i phyogs su 'phang*/ nang du log la gtor chen sgul sha zan sman raka bran la dgug gzhug dang gtor bsngos byas rjes/ gru gsum mthing nag ma byas la gtor ma'i lha ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ slar gtor ma gshin rje'i dmag dpung du bskyed la bstod ring e ring bskul/ sgo phyir spags la zlog byang chung ba gyer/ sha zan dang sman raka bran/ dbye dgug gtor bsngos byas la drag bskul

e thung dang*/ lcags sam bhan+dha/ zlog sngags/ rbod gtong zor 'phen pa'i sngags sdebs/ 'byung ba khram zlog dang bcas pas dgra 'dre gnod pa'i phyogs thebs thog tu 'phang*/ gtor mnan sogs zlog pa dkyus ltar bya ba yin no// zhes pa'ang gshin rje tshe bdag yang zlog me'i spu gri'i nyer mkho gtor ma kho nas zlog pa'i las sgrub pa'i lag len du/ 'bri gung pa sngags 'chang thugs kyi rdo rjes/ 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling gi thog kha gser khang du bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
